breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Neglect atmospheric pressure' and uses the formula NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(ρg), which is identical to the flawed incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires including p_atm/(ρg) in the formula. This inconsistency is not resolved.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification omits atmospheric pressure while still using absolute vapor pressure (3.2 kPa), perpetuating the gauge/absolute pressure mixing error. The ground truth resolves this by using absolute pressures throughout with p_atm = 101.3 kPa included in the formula. This inconsistency is not resolved.
